summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Elbit Systems Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting its first-quarter 2026 earnings via a press release. The filing contains standardized financial results—revenues of $2.19 billion, GAAP net income of $160.8 million, EPS of $3.34—and commentary on operational performance, backlog ($30.2 billion), and strategic positioning. There are no disclosed M&A, divestiture, activist, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation events. The press release also mentions a European contract win but provides no terms. Under the 1934 Act, a foreign issuer's 6-K earnings release is routine and does not trigger a special-situations category.
